source_text: ρῶν ποιήσεις αὐτὰ, καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ κανοῦν ἓν, καὶ προσοίσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ τῷ κανῷ, καὶ τὸ μοσχάριον, καὶ τοὺς δύο κριούς. Καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ προσάξεις ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ λούσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ὕδατι. Καὶ λ

pass_b_english: Cyril: …you will make them, and you will set them upon one basket, and you will bring them forward upon the basket, and the calf, and the two rams. And Aaron and his sons you will bring forward upon the doors of the tent of the testimony, and you will wash them in water. And taking the stoles, you will put on Aaron your brother both the foot-reaching tunic, and the shoulder-piece, and the oracle. And you will join for him the oracle toward the shoulder-piece. And you will set the mitre upon his head, and you will set the leaf the holy-thing upon the mitre, and you will take of the oil of the anointing, and you will pour it upon his head, and you will anoint him. And his sons you will bring forward, and you will put tunics on them, and you will gird them with the belts, and you will put around them the headdresses. And priesthood for me will be for them unto the age, and you will perfect Aaron’s hands, and the hands of his sons.’ So then he has ordered a calf and two rams to be brought forward unto sacrifice… And of the one about to approach God: ‘Innocent in hands and pure in heart.’ (Exodus 29:2–9)

Cyril: And in what manner again the sacrifices for the priests must be exacted, he was legislating saying: ‘And you will bring forward the calf upon the doors of the tent of the testimony, and Aaron and his sons will set their hands upon the head of the calf opposite Lord, beside the doors of the tent of the testimony, and you will slaughter the calf opposite Lord, beside the (Psalm 24:4) (Exodus 29:10–11) (Exodus 29:4–9)
